title: Bledsoe drawing cell diagrams for Taylor's team

tellings.quote: I'm a carpenter and yet I'm reading papers at night that they would send me and my job was to draw whatever came out of me, whatever I saw.

plain: Chris Bledsoe is a carpenter from North Carolina who says he has had strange experiences. He told a podcast host, Jesse Michels, that between about 2008 and 2011 a team linked to a man named Timothy Taylor sent him scientific papers to read at night, and his job was to draw whatever came to him, including diagrams of cells. He mentions Taylor and a scholar named Diana Pasulka in telling it, and if true it would mean researchers took his visions seriously enough to put them to work.
